descriptor: a low, many-legged thing the colour of wet stone
notes: Floor one: genuinely soloable, and deliberately too poor to hold anybody - it exists to teach the loop, not to reward it. Was 7 at aggro 14, which swarmed a lone unarmed diver and killed them before they could put one down: that contradicts D-535's 'floor one is soloable' and made the whole descent a two-person job from the first step. Four at aggro 9 means one or two find you at a time. UNRATIFIED. ⚠ No art: every character in the ingested packs is a biped on the Unreal rig, and this is described as an animal. Left on the appearance seed rather than drawn as a goblin (D-594).
